fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs, including city commission politics and the search for a city manager; discussion of a proposed Miami auditorium and suggested land use near Royal Palm Park; criticism of justice-of-the-peace practices and court delays; coverage of banking service charges on small checking accounts; local public-works concerns (causeway progress, lighting standards, parks and recreation amenities such as shade and drinking water); transportation and road-building politics (including state road department activity); and community entertainment and sports notices and columns.
